prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: CITY ARTERIAL ROAD. Wide multi-lane arterial road in a modern Chinese city at dusk, lined with glass office towers. Traffic packs the lanes with headlights and taillights. The sky darkens from blue to indigo, streetlights flicker on along the median and lit office windows glow from above.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
